summary: Master government accounting with our Advanced Training Course. Gain in-depth knowledge and practical skills to excel in public sector financial management.
lede: Public-sector accounting applies accrual methods and specialized reporting principles to government finances. For experienced public-sector finance professionals, the course covers recognizing exchange and non-exchange revenue, accounting for infrastructure and heritage assets, and consolidating controlled entities. Learners also practice preparing contingent-liability disclosures and financial reports using the IPSAS framework.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for experienced finance professionals operating within the public sector ecosystem who are responsible for high-stakes financial reporting and governance.
modules: Public Sector Accounting Foundations and IPSAS Framework
Accrual Accounting and Revenue Recognition Strategies
Advanced Asset Management and Public Infrastructure Accounting
Liability Management and Social Benefit Accounting
Consolidated Financial Reporting and Entity Control
Digital Transformation and Automated Internal Controls
Strategic Fiscal Reporting and Audit Readiness
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in public sector finance, accounting, or auditing. A working knowledge of basic accounting principles (debits/credits) and familiarity with government budgeting processes is required. No prior experience with IPSAS is mandatory, but it is highly recommended.
